title: Here’s how to order the secret menu Starbucks x The Devil Wears Prada drinks in Canada
snippet: Starbucks has launched a secret menu inspired by The Devil Wears Prada 2 and we got the scoop. Here's exactly how to order each drink in Canada,
extractedText: Fashion and film are colliding in a way that feels both nostalgic and perfectly timed. With the upcoming release of The Devil Wears Prada 2 on May 1, Starbucks is bringing the Runway universe back into our daily routines—one very specific coffee order at a time. View this post on Instagram A post shared by The Devil Wears Prada 2 (@tdwpmovie) Starting April 20, Canadians can tap into a limited-time “secret menu” inspired by the film’s most iconic characters. And yes, it’s now easier than ever to get your hands on them, thanks to in-app customization options and nationwide availability across Starbucks locations in Canada. But here’s the catch: these drinks aren’t listed on the regular menu. So if you want to order like Miranda Priestly (and avoid any… questions), you’ll need to know exactly what to say. ADVERTISEMENT Let’s get into it. Photo: Courtesy of Starbucks What is the Starbucks x The Devil Wears Prada secret menu? As part of a global collaboration tied to the release of The Devil Wears Prada 2, Starbucks has introduced four character-inspired drinks that live exclusively as custom orders—aka, the “secret menu.” Each drink reflects the personality (and energy) of a core character from the film, from high-maintenance precision to effortlessly cool. The drinks are: ADVERTISEMENT Miranda’s Signature Order Andy’s Cappuccino Nigel’s Go-to Doppio Emily’s Fave Iced Chai They’re available in Canada starting April 20 for a limited time. How to order the Starbucks Devil Wears Prada drinks in Canada? Since these aren’t official menu items, you’ll need to order them by customization—either in-store or through the Starbucks app. Here’s exactly how to do it: Image: Design by Stamina team. Original images courtesy of respective partners. Miranda’s signature order This one is all about precision. How to order: ADVERTISEMENT Caffè Latte No foam Extra shot of espresso Extra hot Made with non-fat milk It’s bold, exacting, and completely uncompromising—just like Miranda. Andy’s cappuccino A softer, evolving take on a classic. How to order: ADVERTISEMENT Cappuccino Substitute oat beverage Add caramel syrup Add cinnamon It’s simple, elevated, and quietly stepping into its own. Nigel’s go-to doppio Confident, refined, and a little indulgent. How to order: ADVERTISEMENT Doppio espresso Add espresso con panna (whipped cream) Add mocha Rich, layered, and unapologetically bold—this is insider energy. Emily’s fave iced chai High-strung, particular, and very specific. How to order: ADVERTISEMENT Iced chai latte Substitute almond beverage Add caramel Ask for lower sugar (optional customization) Fussy? Maybe. But also kind of iconic. The vibe: coffee meets culture This collab isn’t just about drinks—it’s about stepping into a cultural moment that defined a generation. The original The Devil Wears Prada turned coffee runs into high-stakes rituals, and now, that same energy is back—this time, IRL. With returning stars like Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci, the sequel is already tapping into peak nostalgia. Starbucks just found a way to make that part of your morning routine. ADVERTISEMENT Why this one hits right now Between fashion nostalgia, character-driven storytelling, and the rise of customizable “secret menu” culture, this collab lands at the intersection of everything people are already engaging with. It’s not just about what you’re ordering—it’s about what it says about you. Are you commanding the room like Miranda? Figuring it out like Andy? ADVERTISEMENT Running the show behind the scenes like Nigel? Or spiralling (just a little) like Emily?
